questions.question: What did Baruch do at Jeremiah's dictation in chapter 36?
options: Built a great altar where all of the people could come to repent
Carried Jeremiah's solemn message far away to the king of Babylon
Hid Jeremiah away in secret from the soldiers who eagerly sought him
Wrote Jeremiah's words on a scroll and read it in the temple
questions.answer: Wrote Jeremiah's words on a scroll and read it in the temple

questions.question: What did King Jehoiakim do with the scroll?
options: Sealed it away in the temple treasury
Cut it with a knife and burned it in the fire
Read it aloud and tore his royal robes in grief
Sent it back to Jeremiah with a warning
questions.answer: Cut it with a knife and burned it in the fire
